summary: A Yes vote authorizes the Santa Paula Unified School District to issue $48.6 million in general obligation bonds, repaid by district property owners, to fund construction and repairs at district school facilities.

tax.text: A Yes vote would approve the bond program and its associated property tax to fund school facility improvements.
tax.quote: The loan repayment comes from a tax on all taxable property (residential, commercial, agricultural, and industrial) located within SPUSD's boundaries.

schools.text: The Yes campaign supports Measure C to fund facilities and programs at Santa Paula Unified School District high schools.
schools.quote: Measure C provides the critical funding to rebuild the Bryden Gym, reconstruct the pool, and expand programs. We must vote YES to ensure our students have the safe, modern environment they deserve.

tax.text: A No vote would not approve the bond program or its associated property tax.
tax.quote: The loan repayment comes from a tax on all taxable property (residential, commercial, agricultural, and industrial) located within SPUSD's boundaries.
